topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchy and stemness properties influence which cell types initiate and propagate tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma create the permissive conditions required for malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Technological approaches to studying tumor evolution and microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental and computational methods used to map mutational timing and spatial cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of malignancy.

topics.label: Conclusion and preview of next lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
